Alternatively, we can give you a 90-minute take-home coding exercise (no whiteboard) with a 2-hour turnaround; share via Drive and you upload when ready. Which of these do you prefer?

Laura — can you confirm your availability for the two short evening segments? Marissa — would you be willing to take the condensed coding slot if we split?
